_doc: Tenant registry — the single source of truth for Phase 3 multi-tenancy (spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-06-phase3-staging-tenant-design.md). Compiled into functions/_lib/tenant-registry.js by scripts/generate-tenant-registry.mjs because Pages Functions cannot read data/*.json at runtime (same pattern as plan-vocab). joinCodeHash is sha256 of the class join code; the plain code is never committed. dbBinding names the per-tenant D1 binding on the Pages project; a tenant whose binding is absent serves 503 on every data route and stores nothing.
